name: Grand Prix

59,0.name: This is where it gets nasty

intro: Find the 3 stars to finish the house. House by Jonathan Chin (alias Paul Finn).
outro:
You know, I really hope you didn't go over the speed limit.
Speeding is illegal in Glider PRO, too!

meta.source: Glider PRO (Casady & Greene, 1994), GNU GPL v2: https://github.com/softdorothy/GliderPRO
notes: 14 walls or floors with two openings: one opening here, the wall between them drawn as a block (Gliderama has one opening per side)
5 doorways were one-way in the original (open on one side only); here they open both ways
8 openings closed and 25 narrowed by walls of invisible obstacles at the rooms' edges
